messages.subject: New to GGIR
parts:
Hi,

Thank you for creating such a sophisticated package for analyzing raw accelerometry data!

I am relatively new to R, and am working through this package using GT3X data. I am wondering how I should begin and how the raw data file needs to be formatted. Do I keep the fileheader with all of the information before using g.inspectfile?

Best,
Jess

The package vignette should be a good starting point for you:
https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html
Best,
Vincent
